title: Sprint 4: Academic foundation
bullets: Classes, subjects, chapters, topics and lessons
English, Hindi and Marathi versions under one lesson
narration: Sprint four. The Academic application foundation. Teams can now organise content by class, subject, chapter and topic, and create a lesson with English, Hindi and Marathi versions.

title: What was built
bullets: FastAPI backend with a PostgreSQL database and migrations
React web app: lessons list, new lesson form, structure management
Every record has a stable UUID and a tenant identifier
Each language version has its own review status
narration: A FastAPI backend with PostgreSQL migrations, and a React web app with a lesson list, a new lesson form, and structure management. Every record has a stable identifier and a tenant identifier. Each language version carries its own review status.

title: Tenant isolation
bullets: Every query is limited to the signed in tenant
Another tenant's records look like they do not exist
Duplicate names and numbers are rejected
Local dev sign in is refused in production
narration: Every query is limited to the signed in tenant. Records of another tenant behave as if they do not exist. Duplicate names are rejected, and the local development sign in is refused in production.

title: Test results
bullets: Frontend type check and production build pass
Create lesson checked in the browser against the real backend
Sign in through Aadi Identity comes next
narration: Eleven backend tests pass against a real PostgreSQL database. The front end type checks and builds. A lesson was created through the browser form against the running backend. Sprint four B adds sign in through Aadi Identity.
